meta.title: ISDS Thematic Watcher — deterministic workflow
meta.note: Repository-grounded manifest. Every node/edge cites its evidence; no evidence = no node. Lanes: control(-2.5) digest(-1.5) core(-0.5) council(0.5) verification(1.5) feedback(2.5).
meta.source_health_omitted: src/source_health.py exists only on unmerged PR #23; excluded until it is on main.

nodes.label: Weekly trigger
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions cron, Mondays 13:00 UTC (plus manual dispatch); concurrency group prevents overlap.

nodes.label: 9 source fetchers
nodes.summary: The registered collectors (ICSID, italaw, IISD ITN, IAReporter headlines, UNCTAD, PCA, Google Alerts, Scholar, News RSS) fetched per run; per-source failure degrades to [] and is recorded in source_health.
evidence: src/main.py: fetch loop with per-source SOURCE-HEALTH status

nodes.label: First-run bootstrap guard
nodes.summary: On an empty seen-state, index everything as seen and send only a baseline note — never classify a historical backlog.
evidence: src/main.py: bootstrap branch (state.is_empty -> index + baseline email)

nodes.label: Dedup vs seen-state
nodes.summary: Every item keyed by source+id in state/seen.json; processed once, never again. Corrupt state restarts rather than stops.

nodes.label: Lexical prescore
nodes.summary: Deterministic three-ring keyword scoring from fingerprint.yaml (ring floor 12; weights sum 100 per ring).

nodes.label: Enrich
nodes.summary: Fetch the source document, strip non-readable content, score sentence doctrinal density, pick the citable line.

nodes.label: LLM classify
nodes.summary: Few-shot contextual classification (strict JSON; one stricter retry; quota/network errors fall back to the lexical score — a verdict is ALWAYS produced and fallbacks are tagged).

nodes.label: Threshold gate
nodes.summary: Matches at >=40 always surface (no cap); quiet weeks fill toward six from candidates >= floor 25 as watch-list leads; below-floor items never surface.

nodes.label: Digest render + archive
nodes.summary: Annotated-bibliography digest rendered and archived to digests/<date>/ (README, articles/, meta.json with per-source counts).

nodes.label: DIGEST email
nodes.summary: The weekly Thematic Watch digest emailed to the recipients (for Dr. Benavides).

nodes.label: Public site
nodes.summary: docs/ generated from source; two-way sync guard (PR gate + push-to-main auto-sync) stops site drift.

nodes.label: Daily council meeting
nodes.summary: Daily chairman+researcher routine commits analytics/daily-research/<date>.md; emailer adds the deterministic numbers-of-record banner and consistency warning.

nodes.label: Chairman
nodes.summary: Sets the weekly agenda from the carried open threads.

nodes.label: Analyst
nodes.summary: Interprets the week against the research question with bounded web search; canonical living memory embedded in-prompt; emits candidate_claims and GAP-UNRESOLVED markers.

nodes.label: Verification ledger
nodes.summary: Append-only event log; state derived by replay; only the operator CLI can change a claim's status.

nodes.label: Operator marks
nodes.summary: Emory's verified/rejected marks via scripts/verify.py (chat-verification convention: operator confirms in chat, assistant runs the clerical mark).

nodes.label: Integrity gate
nodes.summary: Deterministic, model-free: every analyst claim resolved by exact claim_id against the ledger — asserted / unverified lead / route-to-professor / operator-rejected blocked.

nodes.label: Citation check
nodes.summary: Model-free hallucination backstop over the brief's own citations; URL-less authorities flagged for human verification.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.summary: Turns the gated memo into the structured Research Brief (strict JSON schema) honoring the gate's assert/lead/route framing.

nodes.label: RESEARCH BRIEF email
nodes.summary: The interpretive weekly brief emailed separately from the digest; full council memo archived to briefs/<date>-memo.md.

nodes.label: Chairman minutes -> council log
nodes.summary: Weekly reconvene minutes (status, per-member accountability, next steps, escalations) recorded fail-loud: a failed stage marks the entry MINUTES MISSING instead of writing a silent stub.

nodes.label: Monday review packet
nodes.summary: Operator packet at 16:30 UTC Monday (after the council): roundtable from the council's committed record, ledger-sampled claims with ready-to-paste mark commands.

nodes.label: Open threads + gap counters
nodes.summary: The autoprompt loop: editor's open threads and the deterministic GAP-UNRESOLVED counters persist in state/research_log.json and feed next week's chairman; gaps escalate to operator action items at three sessions.

nodes.label: Commit artifacts
nodes.summary: The run commits state/, digests/, docs/, and briefs/ back to main as github-actions[bot] (rebase-retry push).
